scope: Read-only source and sample-data review; no credential audit, network penetration test, browser test, deployment, or account change.

officialSources.supports: GitHub Free public repository Pages; static assets; github.io default URL
HTTPS traffic encryption; github.io automatic HTTPS; Pages public even if source repository private
Removing a file from latest revision does not remove historical copies or third-party clones

resolved.objection: Does public deployment Git history require keeping Workers as default?
resolved.decision: No: a fresh public artifact-only history does not copy private source history; previous public releases remain public and that tradeoff must be explicit.

resolved.objection: Does current audience editing permit modifying the server source?
resolved.decision: No server write API is present; viewer-control cleanup is optional UX/release consistency work, while notes removal is the actual publication-data boundary.

resolved.objection: Does initial publishing require new cross-repository CI credentials?
resolved.decision: No: initial local package review and git push use existing Git authentication; cross-repository CI permissions are a separate later option.
